Mouth is a tiny navy open centre in a cream/brass circular rim at left. Arrows broad CREAM/BRASS with navy outlines and a little warning-red at arrowhead if useful. Three readable inward arrows, clear gaps; do not make a recycling emblem or arrows pointing away from mouth. No face, monster, lips or letters.
